text_block_list.text:
With the second leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Nippon Derby, drawing near, a 
piece of news suddenly came in—

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see?! Duramente-senpai's 
announcement. It's incredible, she really 
feels like she's on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san! Is it true that you 
registered to run in the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
during the Classic Year!! It's a massive 
challenge, so please tell us how you're 
feeling heading into it!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—At this stage, all we have done is 
submit the entry."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, I have a duty to prove I am the 
strongest of my generation. If I should 
accomplish that at the Nippon Derby—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The "World's Strongest"—meaning the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe will come into view. 
This is a stepping stone for that.

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in the 
Classic Year, huh! Still, if it's 
Duramente-senpai, she just might pull it 
off.

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're definitely gonna cheer during 
the Japan Derby, okay!? I just HAVE to see 
Duramente-senpai show everyone she's the 
strongest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally!! Ahh, I can't wait to see it— 
Duramente-senpai's Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Duramente-san really is serious 
about becoming the "strongest"...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I can see why people cheer for him... 
Seeing that run in the Satsuki Sho, even I 
found myself thinking the same thing—)

Ah, found you! So this is where you were, 
Cheval!
Hey, would you come with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ――Yaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――...*pant*... *pant*. ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks, Cheval, for agreeing to train 
alongside me. I'd like to do one more run, 
if that's alright with you?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. I'm fine... I don't really have 
any plans anyway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's a relief! I want to get a 
solid feel for the real deal, but I'm 
still not quite satisfied with it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...By "the main event," do you mean the 
Derby?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Because to make the 
greatest contribution to the racing world, 
there is no better stage than the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...My mission as a Satono Umamusume is to 
show a flawless victory in a G1 race and 
bring excitement to the entire racing 
world."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still, a grand stage demands preparation 
to match."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fitting... preparation...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Analyzing past races and figuring out 
your own path to victory from them. For 
example—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Unlike the tight turns of Nakayama, the 
Derby's Tokyo Racecourse is a wide and 
spacious track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
With a longer straight, there's less chaos 
in how the race unfolds. In other words—it 
becomes a pure contest of raw ability.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"In contrast, my weapon is my closing kick 
on the final stretch. I have to polish it 
without fail before the real deal so that 
it'll work."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to race with 
you—someone whose legs hold out till the 
end, pushing me right to the wire.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: All of that... just for the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(So this is what it means to put 
everything into winning. Never letting 
your eyes wander, not even for a 
second...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Miss Crown, you really aren't bothered, 
are you? ...About Miss Duramente's "Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san? Oh please, of course I care 
about her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If I can't beat her, my dream won't come 
true. And yet, she's already dreaming of 
what lies beyond the Derby, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated when I first heard it. It 
was as good as being told we weren't even 
on their radar. But you know—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Looking too far ahead and tripping over 
your own feet is an all-too-common tale. 
If you slack on your preparations, you're 
always the one left in tears—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, I reconsidered and thought it'd 
actually be nice if they let their guard 
down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not in some distant future— I will seize 
victory *now*.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Crown-san... never looks away. Not from 
her dreams, and not from what she wants.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san is the same. The two of 
them know what they need to do for their 
dreams. That's why they can give it their 
all—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What do I really want to do...? For the 
sake of my dream, what should I...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Crown-san. I want to run more, too. 
So...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right, shall we get going soon? Let's both 
give it everything we've got—!

"I called Cheval Grand over to tell her 
our plans for the next race."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh? T-The Japanese Derby... did you 
say...!?
choice_data_list: Are you still scared after all?

text_block_list.text:
"The Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) is, of 
course, the prestigious GI race that 
determines the strongest of a generation."

Therefore, lacking confidence as she did, 
I never thought she would volunteer to run 
herself. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Crown-san and Duramente-san... What makes 
the two of them so amazing is that they 
never look away from their dreams...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Then, what is my dream...? The thing I 
absolutely want to achieve is—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...T-The Derby is... the race that they 
ran in too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (A great Umamusume... My idol...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-To be honest, I don't have any 
confidence in myself at all... B-But—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (If I can stand on that stage too...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'll do it. Please let me run in the 
Japan Derby...!

And so arrived the day of the Japanese 
Derby—
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Crown-san has such a confident look on 
her face... Of course she does. After 
preparing this much—)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa, w-what is it, Kita-san...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"The Derby really is incredible... The 
anticipation and excitement just keep 
swelling up—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The "Japanese Derby" I've always dreamed 
of... Where Teio-san won and became a huge 
star—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's so much hotter than I ever 
imagined... To win right here, everything 
I've done until now was—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I... I still want my dream to come true. 
No, I'm definitely going to make it come 
true!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've been running all this 
time! Chasing after her back, on and on 
and on... forever—!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san's eyes are blazing... With a 
pure, burning desire to win...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... feels that way. To win, 
that's why we're all here—)

A once-in-a-lifetime challenge for the 
crown of the generation's strongest. With 
everyone's dreams on the line, the curtain 
rises on the Japanese Derby—
